headers.subject: Staff Software Engineer at Wren Aerospace

snippet: Hi Mateo, I lead engineering recruiting at Wren Aerospace. Your background in simulation tooling caught my eye for our Staff Software Engineer opening.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

I lead engineering recruiting at Wren Aerospace. Your background in simulation tooling caught my eye for our Staff Software Engineer opening on the flight software team (remote within Mexico or the US). Would you be open to a short conversation this week?

Role details: https://wren-aero.example/careers/staff-software-engineer

Best regards,
Oliver Grant
Head of engineering recruiting, Wren Aerospace

extraction.summary: Wren Aerospace recruiter reached out about a Staff Software Engineer role.
